answer: Every vote entering consensus rides a relay bridge: a ballot may only be whispered into the ledger after the relaying peer posts an escrow matched to the ballot's weight. When a ballot fails cold-start verification, the ledger voids it and the relaying peer forfeits 10% of its escrow, so an attacker flooding fake identities burns 25,000 POA in escrow for every fake identity it fields, while honest relays reclaim escrow in full at epoch close.
